---
title: "Class 11: Tensor-Product Basis Functions in 2D"
subtitle: "Building 2D Lagrange bases from 1D ones"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <script src="plotly.min.js"></script>
---

A 2D Lagrange basis function on the parent square $[-1,1]^2$ is the product of
one 1D basis function in $\xi$ and one in $\eta$:

$$
N_A(\xi,\eta) = N_a(\xi)\,N_b(\eta), \qquad A = a + (p_\xi+1)\,b .
$$

The index $\xi$ varies fastest.
<!--, which matches `ExtractMultiIndexFromSingleIndex`
from HW6. -->
The interpolation points are equally spaced.

In the 3D plot:

* **Blue curve on the back wall** ($\eta = 1$): the 1D factor $N_a(\xi)$.
* **Orange curve on the side wall** ($\xi = -1$): the 1D factor $N_b(\eta)$.
* **Dashed slices**: every cut through the surface is a 1D function times a constant,
  $N_A(\xi,\eta_0) = N_b(\eta_0)\,N_a(\xi)$ and $N_A(\xi_0,\eta) = N_a(\xi_0)\,N_b(\eta)$.
* **Nodes**: $N_A = 1$ at its own node (gold) and $0$ at every other node (black).

Drag the 3D plot to rotate it; the view is kept when you change a slider. Hover over the surface or curves to read values.

## The 1D factors

Each panel shows every 1D basis function of that degree (grey), the active one
(solid), and the 2D slice along that direction (dashed), which is the active one
scaled by the printed constant.

```{=html}
<div class="tpb-pair">
  <div><div class="tpb-readout" id="ro_xi"></div><div id="plot_xi" style="width:100%;height:370px;"></div></div>
  <div><div class="tpb-readout" id="ro_eta"></div><div id="plot_eta" style="width:100%;height:370px;"></div></div>
</div>
```

## Strides: from $(a,b)$ to $A$

Looking straight down on the element, the basis functions sit on a
$(p_\xi+1)\times(p_\eta+1)$ grid of nodes. Each direction gets a stride,
$s_0 = 1$ and $s_i = \prod_{j=0}^{i-1}(p_j+1)$, so

$$
A = \sum_i a_i\,s_i = a\cdot 1 + b\,(p_\xi+1)\;\big[\,+\;c\,(p_\xi+1)(p_\eta+1)\text{ in 3D}\big],
\qquad a_i = (A \,/\!/\, s_i) \bmod (p_i+1).
$$

A step in $\xi$ changes $A$ by 1; a step in $\eta$ jumps a whole row, $p_\xi+1$.
The plot is the current $N_A$ seen from above, with each node labelled by its $A$.
Click any node to select that basis function; the sliders and plots above follow.

```{=html}
<div class="tpb-pair">
  <div id="plot_top" style="width:100%;height:440px;"></div>
  <div>
    <table class="table table-sm" style="font-family:monospace;max-width:420px">
      <thead><tr><th>direction</th><th>index</th><th>stride s<sub>i</sub></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="stride_rows"></tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="tpb-readout" id="ro_stride" style="white-space:pre"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);

// equally spaced points on [-1, 1]
const lin = n => Array.from({length: n}, (_, i) => -1 + 2*i/(n-1));
const S = lin(61);

// 1D Lagrange basis function a of degree p through equally spaced points
function lagrange(p, a, x){
  const pts = lin(p + 1);
  let v = 1;
  for (let j = 0; j <= p; j++) if (j !== a) v *= (x - pts[j])/(pts[a] - pts[j]);
  return v;
}

const colors = {xi:"#1f5fbf", eta:"#c2410c", node:"#e0a800", ink:"#18202b",
                grey:"#9aa3ae", neg:"#2f6db5", mid:"#f2f2f0", pos:"#b8322a"};

function render(){
  const pxi = +$("pxi").value, peta = +$("peta").value;
  // keep a <= p_xi and b <= p_eta
  $("a").max = pxi; $("b").max = peta;
  if (+$("a").value > pxi) $("a").value = pxi;
  if (+$("b").value > peta) $("b").value = peta;
  const a = +$("a").value, b = +$("b").value;
  const xi0 = +$("xi0").value, eta0 = +$("eta0").value;
  const on = {walls:$("t_walls").checked, slices:$("t_slices").checked, nodes:$("t_nodes").checked,
              others:$("t_others").checked, mesh:$("t_mesh").checked};
  const c = colors;
  const A = a + (pxi + 1)*b;
  for (const id of ["pxi","peta","a","b"]) $(id + "_o").textContent = $(id).value;
  $("xi0_o").textContent = xi0.toFixed(2); $("eta0_o").textContent = eta0.toFixed(2);

  const Na = S.map(x => lagrange(pxi, a, x));
  const Nb = S.map(y => lagrange(peta, b, y));
  const Z = Nb.map(nb => Na.map(na => nb*na));      // Z[j][i] = N_b(eta_j) N_a(xi_i)
  const Na0 = lagrange(pxi, a, xi0), Nb0 = lagrange(peta, b, eta0);

  // largest magnitude over the surface and all 1D functions, so N = 0
  // sits at the middle of the color scale
  let zabs = 1;
  for (const r of Z) for (const v of r) zabs = Math.max(zabs, Math.abs(v));
  for (let k = 0; k <= pxi; k++) for (const x of S) zabs = Math.max(zabs, Math.abs(lagrange(pxi, k, x)));
  for (let k = 0; k <= peta; k++) for (const y of S) zabs = Math.max(zabs, Math.abs(lagrange(peta, k, y)));

  // ---------- 3D surface with the 1D factors, slices and nodes ----------
  const ones = S.map(() => 1), negs = S.map(() => -1);
  const traces = [{
    type:"surface", x:S, y:S, z:Z, cmin:-zabs, cmax:zabs,
    colorscale:[[0, c.neg], [0.5, c.mid], [1, c.pos]], opacity:0.93,
    colorbar:{thickness:10, len:0.6},
    contours:{x:{show:on.mesh, color:"#555", start:-1, end:1, size:0.1},
              y:{show:on.mesh, color:"#555", start:-1, end:1, size:0.1}},
    hovertemplate:"ξ=%{x:.2f}<br>η=%{y:.2f}<br>N=%{z:.4f}<extra></extra>", name:"N_A"
  }];
  if (on.walls){
    if (on.others){
      for (let k = 0; k <= pxi; k++) if (k !== a)
        traces.push({type:"scatter3d", mode:"lines", x:S, y:ones, z:S.map(x => lagrange(pxi, k, x)),
          line:{color:c.xi, width:2}, opacity:0.25, hoverinfo:"skip", showlegend:false});
      for (let k = 0; k <= peta; k++) if (k !== b)
        traces.push({type:"scatter3d", mode:"lines", x:negs, y:S, z:S.map(y => lagrange(peta, k, y)),
          line:{color:c.eta, width:2}, opacity:0.25, hoverinfo:"skip", showlegend:false});
    }
    traces.push({type:"scatter3d", mode:"lines", x:S, y:ones, z:Na,
      line:{color:c.xi, width:7}, name:`N${a}(ξ) on wall η = 1`});
    traces.push({type:"scatter3d", mode:"lines", x:negs, y:S, z:Nb,
      line:{color:c.eta, width:7}, name:`N${b}(η) on wall ξ = −1`});
  }
  if (on.slices){
    traces.push({type:"scatter3d", mode:"lines", x:S, y:S.map(() => eta0), z:Na.map(v => Nb0*v),
      line:{color:c.xi, width:6, dash:"dash"}, name:`slice η = ${eta0.toFixed(2)}`});
    traces.push({type:"scatter3d", mode:"lines", x:S.map(() => xi0), y:S, z:Nb.map(v => Na0*v),
      line:{color:c.eta, width:6, dash:"dash"}, name:`slice ξ = ${xi0.toFixed(2)}`});
  }
  if (on.nodes){
    const px = lin(pxi + 1), py = lin(peta + 1), nx = [], ny = [], nz = [], txt = [];
    for (let j = 0; j <= peta; j++) for (let i = 0; i <= pxi; i++){
      if (i === a && j === b) continue;
      nx.push(px[i]); ny.push(py[j]); nz.push(0); txt.push(`A=${i + (pxi + 1)*j} (a=${i}, b=${j})`);
    }
    traces.push({type:"scatter3d", mode:"markers", x:nx, y:ny, z:nz, text:txt,
      marker:{size:4, color:c.ink}, name:"nodes (N = 0)",
      hovertemplate:"%{text}<br>N_A = 0<extra></extra>"});
    traces.push({type:"scatter3d", mode:"markers", x:[px[a]], y:[py[b]], z:[1],
      marker:{size:7, color:c.node, line:{color:c.ink, width:1}}, name:`node A=${A} (N = 1)`});
  }
  const zmin = Math.min(-0.35, -0.4*zabs) - 0.05;
  Plotly.react("plot3d", traces, {
    uirevision:"keep-camera",
    title:{text:`N<sub>${A}</sub>(ξ,η) = N<sub>${a}</sub>(ξ) · N<sub>${b}</sub>(η),   p<sub>ξ</sub>=${pxi}, p<sub>η</sub>=${peta}`},
    margin:{l:0, r:0, t:40, b:0}, legend:{x:0, y:1},
    scene:{xaxis:{title:"ξ", range:[-1, 1]}, yaxis:{title:"η", range:[-1, 1]},
      zaxis:{title:"N", range:[zmin, zabs + 0.05]},
      aspectmode:"manual", aspectratio:{x:1, y:1, z:0.75},
      camera:{eye:{x:-1.45, y:-1.65, z:0.95}}}
  }, {responsive:true, displaylogo:false});

  // ---------- 1D panels ----------
  draw1D("plot_xi", pxi, a, xi0, Nb0, "ξ", "η", c.xi, on);
  draw1D("plot_eta", peta, b, eta0, Na0, "η", "ξ", c.eta, on);
  $("ro_xi").textContent = `N${A}(ξ, η₀=${eta0.toFixed(2)}) = N${b}(η₀)·N${a}(ξ) = ${Nb0.toFixed(4)}·N${a}(ξ)`;
  $("ro_eta").textContent = `N${A}(ξ₀=${xi0.toFixed(2)}, η) = N${a}(ξ₀)·N${b}(η) = ${Na0.toFixed(4)}·N${b}(η)`;

  // ---------- top-down view with strides ----------
  drawTop(pxi, peta, a, b, A, Z, zabs);
}

// all degree-p basis functions, the active one k highlighted, and the
// 2D slice (active one times scale) dashed
function draw1D(div, p, k, s0, scale, v, ov, color, on){
  const tr = [];
  if (on.others)
    for (let j = 0; j <= p; j++) if (j !== k)
      tr.push({x:S, y:S.map(x => lagrange(p, j, x)), mode:"lines",
        line:{color:colors.grey, width:1.2}, name:`N${j}(${v})`, showlegend:false});
  const act = S.map(x => lagrange(p, k, x));
  tr.push({x:S, y:act, mode:"lines", line:{color, width:3}, name:`N${k}(${v})`});
  if (on.slices)
    tr.push({x:S, y:act.map(y => scale*y), mode:"lines", line:{color, width:2, dash:"dash"},
      name:`N_A at ${ov}₀ (= ${scale.toFixed(3)}·N${k}(${v}))`});
  const pts = lin(p + 1);
  tr.push({x:pts, y:pts.map((_, i) => i === k ? 1 : 0), mode:"markers", showlegend:false,
    marker:{size:pts.map((_, i) => i === k ? 11 : 7), color:pts.map((_, i) => i === k ? colors.node : colors.ink)}});
  const shapes = on.slices ? [{type:"line", x0:s0, x1:s0, yref:"paper", y0:0, y1:1,
    line:{color:colors.grey, width:1, dash:"dot"}}] : [];
  Plotly.react(div, tr, {
    title:{text:`1D factor in ${v} (degree ${p})`, font:{size:14}},
    margin:{l:44, r:10, t:40, b:70}, shapes,
    xaxis:{title:v, range:[-1.03, 1.03]}, legend:{orientation:"h", x:0, y:-0.3}
  }, {responsive:true, displaylogo:false, displayModeBar:false});
}

// N_A seen from above, nodes labelled by global index A, with arrows
// showing the stride in each direction from the selected node
function drawTop(pxi, peta, a, b, A, Z, zabs){
  const c = colors, px = lin(pxi + 1), py = lin(peta + 1);
  const nx = [], ny = [], txt = [], cd = [], col = [], size = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= peta; j++) for (let i = 0; i <= pxi; i++){
    const sel = (i === a && j === b);
    nx.push(px[i]); ny.push(py[j]); txt.push(String(i + (pxi + 1)*j)); cd.push([i, j]);
    col.push(sel ? c.node : c.ink); size.push(sel ? 16 : 9);
  }
  const traces = [
    {type:"heatmap", x:S, y:S, z:Z, zmin:-zabs, zmax:zabs, zsmooth:"best",
     colorscale:[[0, c.neg], [0.5, c.mid], [1, c.pos]], showscale:false, hoverinfo:"skip"},
    {type:"scatter", mode:"markers+text", x:nx, y:ny, text:txt, customdata:cd,
     textposition:"top right", textfont:{size:13, color:c.ink},
     marker:{size, color:col, line:{color:"#fff", width:1.5}},
     hovertemplate:"A=%{text}  (a=%{customdata[0]}, b=%{customdata[1]})<extra>click to select</extra>"}
  ];
  const arrow = (i, j, label, color) => ({x:px[i], y:py[j], ax:px[a], ay:py[b], xref:"x", yref:"y",
    axref:"x", ayref:"y", showarrow:true, arrowhead:2, arrowwidth:2.5, arrowcolor:color, text:"",
    standoff:9, startstandoff:9});
  const note = (i, j, label, color, xs, ys) => ({x:(px[a] + px[i])/2, y:(py[b] + py[j])/2, text:label,
    showarrow:false, font:{color, size:13}, xshift:xs, yshift:ys, bgcolor:"rgba(255,255,255,0.8)"});
  const ann = [];
  const ia = a < pxi ? a + 1 : a - 1, jb = b < peta ? b + 1 : b - 1;
  ann.push(arrow(ia, b, "", c.xi), note(ia, b, (ia > a ? "+" : "−") + "1", c.xi, 0, -14));
  ann.push(arrow(a, jb, "", c.eta), note(a, jb, (jb > b ? "+" : "−") + (pxi + 1), c.eta, 16, 0));
  Plotly.react("plot_top", traces, {
    title:{text:`top-down view of N<sub>${A}</sub>`, font:{size:14}},
    margin:{l:40, r:10, t:40, b:40}, annotations:ann, showlegend:false,
    xaxis:{title:"ξ", range:[-1.12, 1.12], zeroline:false, showgrid:false},
    yaxis:{title:"η", range:[-1.15, 1.25], zeroline:false, showgrid:false, scaleanchor:"x"}
  }, {responsive:true, displaylogo:false, displayModeBar:false});

  const s1 = pxi + 1, s2 = (pxi + 1)*(peta + 1);
  $("stride_rows").innerHTML =
    `<tr><td>ξ</td><td>a = ${a}</td><td>s₀ = 1</td></tr>` +
    `<tr><td>η</td><td>b = ${b}</td><td>s₁ = p_ξ+1 = ${s1}</td></tr>` +
    `<tr style="opacity:.55"><td>ζ (3D)</td><td>c</td><td>s₂ = (p_ξ+1)(p_η+1) = ${s2}</td></tr>`;
  $("ro_stride").textContent =
    `A = ${a}·1 + ${b}·${s1} = ${A}\n` +
    `a = (${A} // 1) mod ${pxi + 1} = ${a}\n` +
    `b = (${A} // ${s1}) mod ${peta + 1} = ${b}\n` +
    `Python:  r, a = divmod(${A}, ${pxi + 1})  ->  r = ${Math.floor(A/(pxi + 1))}, a = ${a}\n` +
    `         r, b = divmod(${Math.floor(A/(pxi + 1))}, ${peta + 1})  ->  r = 0, b = ${b}`;
}

for (const id of ["pxi","peta","a","b","xi0","eta0"]) $(id).addEventListener("input", render);
for (const id of ["t_walls","t_slices","t_nodes","t_others","t_mesh"]) $(id).addEventListener("change", render);
render();
$("plot_top").on("plotly_click", e => {
  const pt = e.points.find(q => q.customdata);
  if (!pt) return;
  $("a").value = pt.customdata[0]; $("b").value = pt.customdata[1];
  render();
});
})();
</script>
```

## Things to try

1. Set $p_\xi = p_\eta = 1$. Every basis function is a bilinear "tent corner", and each
   slice is a straight line.
2. Set $p_\xi = p_\eta = 2$ and pick the center node $(a,b) = (1,1)$. This is the
   interior "bubble" function; it is zero on the whole boundary of the element.
3. Pick an edge node such as $(a,b) = (1,0)$ and move $\eta_0$ onto $\eta = 0$ or
   $\eta = 1$. The dashed $\xi$-slice collapses to zero, because $N_0(\eta)$ vanishes
   at the other $\eta$ nodes.
4. Raise the degree to 5 or 6 and look at a basis function next to the boundary.
   The large oscillations in the 1D factors (the Runge effect) carry straight over
   into the 2D surface.
